description: Handwritten by O'Keeffe in pencil on verso: "Greetings for 1960 from my//poor house —//I go to N.Y.//tomorrow for a week. I //may—hope to return on the // 22nd—certainly not//later than Jan. 25th. Will//you plan to come on the 25th//or after—I will be staying// with Jean LeDoux if you//wish to reach me. Will write//you from N.Y. if I can—//Looking forward to your coming// through this poor door—G." Sent to Charles Wickham Moore.
